name: Cali Blaze Tarantula Preroll | Green Apple
description:
Sour, crisp, and tart. The sativa genetics make this one energizing — think morning smoke or afternoon pick-me-up. The green apple flavor is punchy without being artificial. Clean finish with a slight citrus edge.

* Liquid Diamond Infused: Injected with concentrate for amplified potency.
* Kief Crusted: Rolled in kief for an extra layer of flavor and THC.
